rule: Assumption register (FRAMEWORK.md area 13(b)): every constant the FinOps IQ v3 value model and scoring use, and the client inputs they rest on, each with value, basis (client input / published source with claim ID / LTM heuristic with reasoning), confidence and sensitivity (what changes if it is wrong). 'constants' lists the registry values each entry covers; the test packages/engine-core/test/finops-iq-v3-value.test.ts checks that every constant the code reads is listed here with the same value. The report's 'How we calculated this' appendix (F7) lists them all.

basisValues.client_input: Given by the client (exact, band or evidence)
basisValues.published_source: Published source with a claim ID in the claims register
basisValues.ltm_heuristic: LTM heuristic with reasoning; not a market fact

assumptions.title: Complexity tier points: spend bands and scope points
assumptions.value: Spend under USD 1M = 0, 1-10M = 1, 10-50M = 2, over 50M = 3; +1 or +2 for providers, +1 each for Kubernetes, AI, SaaS or licensing, private cloud or data centre, 5 or more consuming units
assumptions.reasoning: Scale and the number of platforms drive how much practice an estate needs; points keep the tier explainable.
assumptions.sensitivity: Targets shift one level, so the gap count changes; the value model is unchanged
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Complexity tier materiality tests
assumptions.value: Kubernetes counts at 10% or more of compute; AI API at 5% or more of in-scope spend (any GPU spend counts)
assumptions.reasoning: A token use of a scope should not move the tier; applied only when the inputs exist.
assumptions.sensitivity: A borderline estate moves one tier
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Complexity tier bands
assumptions.value: 0-2 points Tier 1, 3-5 Tier 2, 6 or more Tier 3
assumptions.reasoning: Three tiers are enough to vary targets and effort without false precision.
assumptions.sensitivity: Targets, effort per lever and the FinOps team size shift with the tier
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Default target per capability and tier
assumptions.value: Table in DESIGN.md 3.4 (capabilities.json defaultTargets)
assumptions.reasoning: After the Foundation's guidance that each capability should be at the level the business needs, not Run everywhere.
assumptions.sensitivity: Gaps, findings and the need index move one level per changed target
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

value.runReason: Everything else depends on complete, timely data
Unallocated spend cannot be owned, charged back or unit-costed
Many consumers of cost data at this scale
Absolute cost of an undetected spike scales with spend
A standing practice is needed at this scale
Guardrails must be automated across many teams

assumptions.title: Severity and schedule rules
assumptions.value: Gap 1/2/3 = Medium/High/Critical; +1 for Data Ingestion, Allocation and Practice Operations at Tier 2-3; at least High when a linked lever is 2% or more of P; waves from months 0/3/9; a capability gap moves one level at a time, first level at 3 months and each further level 6 months later (durations 3/9/15 months for gaps 1/2/3); other findings 3/6/12/24 months by severity; first milestone 3 months; DECISION-01 High, +1 at Tier 2-3; executive view shows the top five
assumptions.reasoning: Foundations other capabilities depend on, and high-value levers, come first. Maturity is built a level at a time (Crawl to Walk to Run), so severity orders the work rather than shortening it. Planning defaults the consultant can change with a reason.
assumptions.sensitivity: The order of the roadmap; no value figure changes
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F3 rule corrections); per-level durations approved for M5 on 22 Oct 2026 (M4 CIO challenge D4)

assumptions.title: Capability rating rule
assumptions.value: Weakest answered core question, lowered by at most one level by a depth answer; Unknown counts as the lowest level
assumptions.reasoning: Monotone and explainable; one depth answer does not collapse a mature core practice (Q9).
assumptions.sensitivity: One capability moves one level
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F3 rule corrections)

assumptions.title: Allocation coverage bands (UN-04)
assumptions.value: Run more than 90%, Walk 85-90%, Crawl below 85% (including below 70%), Not yet when allocation is not measured
assumptions.reasoning: Band floors adopt the Foundation's current sample goals; the adaptation is LTM's.
assumptions.sensitivity: Allocation moves one level
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Scheduled report count (UN-08)
assumptions.value: 5 report types = Run, 3-4 = Walk, 1-2 = Crawl, none = Not yet
assumptions.reasoning: Equal weight per report type; evenly spaced levels.
assumptions.sensitivity: Reporting & Analytics moves one level
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Anomaly triage and bill-explanation thresholds (UN-10, UN-11)
assumptions.value: Run: triaged within one business day / explained the same day; Walk: weekly / a few days; Crawl: static alerts / weeks
assumptions.reasoning: Mirrors the hours / days / week-or-more awareness ladder.
assumptions.sensitivity: Anomaly Management moves one level
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

value.run: automated detection on all accounts, routed to the owner, triaged within one business day
value.walk: automated detection on major accounts, reviewed at least weekly
value.crawl: static budget or threshold alerts only
weeks, and the answer is contested

assumptions.title: Forecast variance bands (QV-01)
assumptions.value: Run within 5%, Walk 5-10%, Crawl 10-20%, Not yet more than 20%
assumptions.reasoning: Band floors adopt the Foundation's current sample goals.
assumptions.sensitivity: Forecasting moves one level
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

value.run: within plus or minus 5% average per quarter

assumptions.title: Commitment coverage bands (VB-02)
assumptions.value: Below 25%, 25-49%, 50-74%, 75% or more, or exact
assumptions.reasoning: Coverage is a value input, not a maturity score; quartile bands feed LEV-01 and its band corners.
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-01 range width
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

value.bands: below 25%, 25-49%, 50-74%, 75% or more, don't know (exact allowed in workshop)
value.maturity: none: coverage is a value input, not a maturity rating
value.kpiContext: Foundation sample goals about 60% (Crawl), more than 75% (Walk), more than 80% (Run), shown as published context only

assumptions.title: Commitment lifecycle follow-up trigger (OP-02)
assumptions.value: Asked when coverage is unknown or below 50%, or OP-01 at Crawl or below
assumptions.reasoning: An extra question cannot raise a score, so a generous trigger is safe.
assumptions.sensitivity: One more question asked
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

value.askWhen: eligible coverage unknown or below 50%, or OP-01 at Crawl or below

assumptions.title: Client waste hypothesis bands (HY-01)
assumptions.value: Below 5%, 5-9%, 10-19%, 20-29%, 30% or more, or don't know; shown beside the model, never an input
assumptions.reasoning: Brackets the published self-estimate without implying a normal level.
assumptions.sensitivity: Only the "Your own estimate" line in the report's value section, shown when the client gives an estimate; no number changes (D4)
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Need index and verdict bands
assumptions.value: Mean of (gap / 3) x 100 over executive capabilities with a target, blank or Unknown at the maximum gap, capped at 100; bands 0-25 / 26-50 / 51-75 / 76-100
assumptions.reasoning: FinOps Value Case carry-over, reworded for Q14.
assumptions.sensitivity: The verdict band
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F3 rule corrections)

value.label: Lightweight practices sufficient at current scale

value.bands: 0-25 Lightweight practices sufficient at current scale; 26-50 Targeted improvements needed now; 51-75 Material exposure: act this year; 76-100 Act now
value.urgency: +10 value 5% or more of P, or a blank input leaving LEV-01 or LEV-04 open; +10 growth 20% or more, or unknown; +10 AI in scope; Tier 2 +10, Tier 3 +20

assumptions.title: Need urgency modifiers
assumptions.value: +10 at Tier 2, +20 at Tier 3, +10 when the expected gross run-rate value is 5% or more of P, +10 for growth of 20% or more, +10 when AI is in scope
assumptions.reasoning: Gaps cost more at scale, in a growing estate, with AI spend and where the value at stake is material.
assumptions.sensitivity: The verdict band, by 10 points per modifier
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F3 rule corrections)

value.note: Share of P in value-rules.json (scoring.needModifierShareOfP), applied from F4

assumptions.title: Verdict confidence
assumptions.value: Medium when every asked maturity question has a level; Low with any blank or Don't know; never High in executive mode
assumptions.reasoning: Executive mode rests on few answers and no evidence.
assumptions.sensitivity: The confidence label only
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F3 rule corrections)

assumptions.title: Expected case = half of the upper case
assumptions.reasoning: PLAN F4 requires expected at most half of upper unless a sourced capture rate exists; Google's 1-year flexible CUD (28%) is close to half its 55% maximum.
assumptions.sensitivity: Every expected figure moves in proportion
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Conservative case = a quarter of the upper case
assumptions.reasoning: Half of the expected case; a floor a CFO can hold the programme to.
assumptions.sensitivity: Every conservative figure moves in proportion
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Band handling
assumptions.value: Expected at every band midpoint; conservative the lowest and upper the highest total over the band corners (at most 8 banded inputs, widest first; the midpoint is also a candidate); a lower case's year-1 is lowered pro rata so it never exceeds the year-1 of the case above
assumptions.reasoning: Bands widen the range and never inflate it; one value per input in each case keeps the upper case a consistent scenario.
assumptions.sensitivity: Range width only
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Non-production on-schedule hours
assumptions.value: 50 of 168 hours a week (LEV-04 maximum 1 - 50/168 = 70.24%, stored as 0.7023809524)
assumptions.reasoning: A 10-hour, 5-day week; AWS uses the same 168-to-50-hour example.
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-04 moves about 6% for every 10 hours of schedule
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Target utilisation for Kubernetes requests and GPUs
assumptions.reasoning: Headroom for peaks; replaces the unsourced 4x over-provisioning claim.
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-07 and LEV-10 (at 35% measured use, a 0.75 target raises the maximum from 46% to 53%)
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Ramp: year-1 share of run-rate value per lever
assumptions.value: LEV-01, 03, 04 0.5; LEV-02, 05, 10 0.33; LEV-06, 07 0.25; LEV-09 the share of contracts renewing in year 1, else 0.25; years 2 and 3 = 1.0; each from the start month of the finding that owns the lever (ASM-FIN-064)
assumptions.reasoning: Commitments in quarterly tranches; clean-up and scheduling are quick; rightsizing, storage, Spot and Kubernetes need engineering cycles; licences at renewal.
assumptions.sensitivity: Year-1 and 3-year figures; never the run-rate
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: One-off effort per lever (FTE-months, Tier 1 / 2 / 3)
assumptions.reasoning: Proportional to the number of teams and platforms that must change; counted only for levers with a positive expected value (F4 review M1).
assumptions.sensitivity: Net figures: each FTE-month moves net by one internal rate
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Ongoing lever effort
assumptions.value: 20% of the lever's one-off effort per year
assumptions.reasoning: Levers decay without upkeep: commitments expire, schedules drift, requests creep.
assumptions.sensitivity: Net run-rate and 3-year net
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Evidence freshness
assumptions.value: 90 days
assumptions.reasoning: Provider recommendations change with usage, prices and commitments; matches the register's 90-day review of volatile items (D14).
assumptions.sensitivity: Whether LEV-02, LEV-03 and LEV-05 are quantified
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Coverage basis approximation
assumptions.value: Coverage (on-demand-equivalent) treated as a share of billed compute
assumptions.reasoning: Avoids asking for a second coverage measure in an executive session.
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-01 slightly high when coverage is already above 50%
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Global cap
assumptions.value: 29% of in-scope public cloud spend, on the conservative, expected and upper cases; the headline % of P is public cloud only; LEV-09 outside the base and shown on its own; not lifted by evidence in version 1.0
assumptions.reasoning: Flexera 2026 State of the Cloud (n = 753): respondents' average self-estimate of wasted IaaS and PaaS spend, used only as a ceiling (D15, Q11).
assumptions.sensitivity: Binding only at extreme inputs (RS3 and RS5 upper cases); a lower cap lowers those upper cases
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

value.citation: Flexera 2026 State of the Cloud Report: respondents' average self-estimate of wasted IaaS/PaaS spend (used as a ceiling only) [CLM-FIN-040, CLM-FIN-138]

assumptions.title: No spend growth applied
assumptions.reasoning: Values are on today's spend; conservative when spend grows.
assumptions.sensitivity: Understates value in a growing estate; overstates it if spend falls
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Executive mode: scheduled share from OP-06
assumptions.value: Run 1.0, Walk 0.5, Crawl or Not yet 0; Unknown leaves LEV-04 unquantified and treats all non-production as unscheduled for LEV-01
assumptions.reasoning: Lets executive mode quantify LEV-04 without another question; Unknown takes the most conservative path.
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-04 and LEV-01 in executive mode
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Executive mode duration
assumptions.value: 45-60 seconds per question
assumptions.reasoning: To be measured in F6 browser tests.
assumptions.sensitivity: Session length only
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: FinOps team cost beside the value
assumptions.value: 0.5 / 1 / 2 FTE at Tier 1 / 2 / 3, x 12 months x the internal rate; shown when DECISION-01 is raised, never netted
assumptions.reasoning: A part-time lead in a focused estate, a full-time lead at scale, a lead and an analyst in a complex estate (Q12).
assumptions.sensitivity: The operating-model cost shown beside the value; no value figure changes
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Lever, scope-confirmation and DECISION-02 finding rules
assumptions.value: Lever finding Medium (Low at zero, High with the value uplift) when its capability has no gap finding; LEV-03 and LEV-04 in wave 1; scope confirmation Medium when it blocks LEV-01 or LEV-04, else Low, wave 1, within 3 months; DECISION-02 High, wave 2
assumptions.reasoning: Value is counted once and shown on the finding that owns it; missing inputs are asked for; commitments follow usage changes.
assumptions.sensitivity: Finding count and order; no value figure changes
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Value thresholds in scoring
assumptions.value: Severity uplift when a lever's shown expected net run-rate is 2% or more of its base (P for public cloud levers; SaaS and licensing spend, else total in-scope spend, for LEV-09); need modifier when the shown expected public cloud value is 5% or more of P; only shown figures at the client's own answers, named on the finding and the verdict
assumptions.reasoning: High-value levers come first; a CIO asking why a finding is High is pointed to a number in the report (F4 review H3).
assumptions.sensitivity: A finding moves one severity level; the need index moves 10 points
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Rounding
assumptions.value: Value figures rounded down, costs rounded up, to whole currency units
assumptions.reasoning: Rounding never flatters the net.
assumptions.sensitivity: At most one currency unit per figure
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Money shown only with an internal rate; external support not included
assumptions.value: No value figure without cost.internalRate (Q4); net covers internal effort and tooling only until WS-S5 sets external support ranges (Q10)
assumptions.reasoning: A net figure needs a cost; an assumed salary would be unsourced.
assumptions.sensitivity: Net would fall by the external support cost once included
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Banded cost inputs
assumptions.value: A banded internal rate or tooling cost uses its high end in the conservative case and its low end in the upper case
assumptions.reasoning: The conservative case should be conservative on cost as well as on value.
assumptions.sensitivity: Net range width only
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Provider published maximum discounts
assumptions.value: AWS 72% (Savings Plans / RIs), Azure 72% (reservations), Google Cloud 55% (resource-based CUD); Spot AWS 90%, Azure 90%, Google Cloud 91%; OCI, IBM, Alibaba not quantified
assumptions.reasoning: Read on 14 Oct 2026 through web-search results quoting the provider pricing pages (direct fetches are blocked from the build environment), as the claims register records; volatile, reviewed every 90 days (D14). A maximum on covered usage, not a bill-level saving.
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-01 and LEV-06 in proportion; a lower Spot maximum also shifts usage back to LEV-01
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

ec2_instance_sp_or_ri.label: EC2 Instance Savings Plans or Standard Reserved Instances

assumptions.title: Spot independent of commitment coverage
assumptions.value: Spot-movable usage = (interruption-tolerant share - share on Spot) x (1 - eligible coverage); the same share leaves LEV-01
assumptions.reasoning: Tolerant usage already covered by commitments is billed below on-demand and its commitment cannot simply be released; without data on which usage the commitments cover, coverage is assumed to fall evenly (F4 review H2).
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-06 in proportion to (1 - coverage); at high coverage Spot value falls sharply
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Commitment instrument default
assumptions.value: The lower published maximum per provider when the client does not state its main instrument: AWS 66% (Compute Savings Plans), Azure 65% (savings plan for compute), Google Cloud 55% (resource-based CUDs)
assumptions.reasoning: The higher maxima apply only to specific instruments; the conservative maximum avoids overstating LEV-01 (F4 review M6).
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-01 by up to 6 to 7 percentage points of rate
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Levers not worth pursuing are left out of the headline
assumptions.value: A lever whose expected 3-year value at the margin (after the levers it interacts with) does not exceed its one-off and 3 years of ongoing effort is shown, with its figures, and left out of the totals
assumptions.reasoning: A CFO should not see effort spent on a lever that does not pay back in three years; at the margin, so a lever that mostly displaces another (Spot replacing commitments) is judged on what it adds (F4 review M1).
assumptions.sensitivity: Headline net only; gross figures of the excluded lever are shown beside it
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Ramp starts at the roadmap start
assumptions.value: Year-N share = ramp share x the part of year N left after the owning finding's start month
assumptions.reasoning: Value cannot arrive before the work starts; ties the phasing to the roadmap (F4 review M3).
assumptions.sensitivity: Year-1 and 3-year figures fall for wave 2 and 3 levers; run-rate unchanged
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner on 15 Oct 2026 (F4 gate)

assumptions.title: Internal cost rate per FTE-month
assumptions.value: Client input (VB-09; the consultant sets it at executive setup)
assumptions.reasoning: Only the client knows its loaded cost; no default is assumed (Q4).
assumptions.sensitivity: Every cost and net figure and the FinOps team cost in proportion
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Annual tooling cost
assumptions.value: Client input (VB-09); when not provided, net excludes it and says so
assumptions.reasoning: Never assumed zero silently.
assumptions.sensitivity: Net run-rate and 3-year net by the tooling cost
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: In-scope public cloud spend by provider (P)
assumptions.value: Client input (SC-04), exact or band
assumptions.reasoning: The base of every public cloud lever and of the global cap.
assumptions.sensitivity: Every public cloud lever and the cap in proportion
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Value-base shares
assumptions.value: Client inputs (VB-01 to VB-04, VB-06): compute, steady-state, non-production, coverage, scheduled, interruption-tolerant, Spot, cluster spend and utilisation
assumptions.reasoning: No default share without a published source: a missing share leaves its lever unquantified.
assumptions.confidence: As given (Low when banded or derived)
assumptions.sensitivity: The levers that use them; see each lever's formula
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Provider-tool savings estimates
assumptions.value: Client evidence (VB-05) by recommendation type, no older than 90 days; used as given when deduplicated, otherwise reduced pro rata for idle clean-up and scheduling
assumptions.reasoning: The provider tools see utilisation that a questionnaire cannot.
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-02, LEV-03 and LEV-05 in proportion
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Measured AI, GPU and SaaS evidence
assumptions.value: Client evidence (VB-07, VB-08): GPU spend and utilisation, idle endpoints, unused licence cost and renewal share
assumptions.reasoning: Measured by the client's own tools.
assumptions.sensitivity: LEV-09 and LEV-10 in proportion
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner (F1, D1-D15 and Q1-Q14 defaults accepted)

assumptions.title: Effort per level of capability gap, and effort bands
assumptions.value: 1, 2 or 3 FTE-months per level of gap at Tier 1, 2 or 3; bands S up to 3 FTE-months, M up to 9, L above 9
assumptions.reasoning: Closing a level means policy, tooling and adoption work across the owners in scope; larger estates have more owners. Used only for the roadmap's effort band, never for value.
assumptions.sensitivity: Changes a workstream's band by at most one step; no rating or value changes
assumptions.ownerApproval: approved by the owner at the M4 gate (22 Oct 2026)
